newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR DENMARK V SLOVENIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR DENMARK V SLOVENIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup Group One qualifier between Denmark and Slovenia on Wednesday:
Denmark - 1-Peter Schmeichel, 2-Jacob Laursen, 3-Marc Rieper, 4-Jess Hoegh, 5-Jan Heintze, 6-Thomas Helveg, 7-Allan Nielsen, 8-Claus Thomsen, 9-Jon Dahl Tomasson, 10-Per Pedersen, 11-Brian Laudrup.
Slovenia - 1-Bosko Boskovic, 2-Robert Englaro, 3-Ales Krizan, 4-Darko Milanic, 5-Mladen Rodonja, 6-Alfred Jermanis, 7-Doni Novak, 8-Damjan Gajser, 9-Ales Ceh, 10-Primoz Gliha, 11-Ermin Siljak.
